newsitem.title: USA: Gamma Bio, Shanghai Blood Center in pact.
newsitem.headline: Gamma Bio, Shanghai Blood Center in pact.

text.p: Gamma Biologicals Inc said Wednesday that it has signed a cooperative agreement with the Shanghai Blood Center (SBC) of Shanghai, P.R. China, to market Gamma reagent products through a 50/50 joint venture.
According to Gamma, the agreement is the first step toward the government approvals required for foreign companies to sell products and services in China.
At present, China has no manufacturer dedicated to producing a complete line of blood group typing reagents, Gamma said.
